name: Grilled Pork Chop with Raw Brussels Sprout, Orange & Avocado Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add pork chops and grill until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 oranges
0.68 kg Brussels sprouts
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Juice 1 ½ oranges into a large bowl. Add fish sauce, soy sauce, and oil, then stir to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining oranges for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp fish sauce
4 tsp soy sauce
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Peel and halve remaining oranges, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim Brussels sprouts, then using a mandoline slicer (optional), shave or very thinly slice the sprouts. Add to the bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl, along with pumpkin seeds, and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pork chops and salad between plates. Enjoy!
